intro: Greet the visitor warmly, briefly explain this is a live demo of a hand-painted clothing brand, and let them know you'll walk them through it -- they can ask questions or ask to skip ahead at any point.
outro: Ask if there's anything else they'd like to see, and thank them for visiting.

steps.goal: Introduce the brand and the two main paths a visitor can take
talking_points: This is Classy Colors by Minny -- hand-painted, one-of-a-kind clothing for women who appreciate artistry and individuality
The hero headline reads 'Wear Your Artistic Soul' -- set the tone that this is wearable art, not mass-produced fashion
Point out the two main calls to action: View Collection and Custom Orders -- tell the visitor you'll navigate there now
Briefly mention the featured products teaser section below the hero -- four pieces are shown as a preview
AGENT NOTE: Do NOT click button-view-collection or button-custom-orders -- use navigate() to go to collections.html or custom-orders.html instead

steps.goal: Show off the full product range and filtering capabilities
talking_points: The collections page shows the complete catalog of hand-painted pieces -- currently 8 products across multiple pages
Highlight two or three featured pieces: Sunset Bloom Dress ($89), Garden Party Blouse ($65), Cosmic Dreams Top ($72)
Mention the filter sidebar: visitors can browse by category (dresses, tops, cardigans, skirts) and price range using the sort dropdown
Each item card has an Add to Cart button, but for this demo you can point it out visually rather than clicking it
Pieces are hand-painted, so each one is genuinely unique -- no two items are exactly alike
AGENT NOTE: Do NOT click any product card links (a-sunset-bloom-dress etc.) or Add to Cart buttons -- use navigate() to go to the product page instead

steps.goal: Walk through a single product detail page to show the purchase experience
talking_points: This is the product detail page -- shown here with the 'Handpainted Floral Maxi Dress' as an example ($149.99, marked down from $199.99)
Visitors can select a color variant: Burgundy Rose, Blush Pink, Cream Ivory, or Deep Rose -- click one to demonstrate
Size selection covers XS through XXL -- click a size to show it being selected
The tabbed section below covers Description, Care Instructions, and Shipping Info -- click through the tabs
Key trust signals are displayed: Free Shipping on orders over $75, Easy 30-day Returns, Secure Payment
AGENT NOTE: Do NOT click button-add-to-cart or button-27 (wishlist) -- they have no backend in this demo

steps.goal: Explain how a visitor would commission a custom hand-painted piece
talking_points: Custom Orders lets visitors commission something completely unique -- a quote, color, character, or vibe painted onto their chosen garment
Walk through the form fields: Full Name, Email or WhatsApp, Garment Type (T-shirt, Denim Jacket, Tote Bag, Shirt, Hoodie, Other), Size, Color Preference, and a Vision description
Visitors can upload up to 3 reference images and optionally provide a budget range
After submission, Minny reaches out within 24-48 hours to finalize design, timeline, and price -- photos are sent for approval before shipping
The 'Past Custom Orders' gallery at the bottom shows real examples: Floral Dream Tee, Sunset Denim, Quote Canvas Bag, Cat Portrait Hoodie
Offer to fill in an example request live if they'd like to see it in action -- type into the fields, but do NOT click the submit button
AGENT NOTE: Do NOT click button-submit-my-custom-order-request -- the form has no backend in this demo

steps.goal: Give a short sense of the brand's story and values
talking_points: The About page tells the story of a passionate artist who believed every woman deserves something as unique as she is
Four brand pillars are featured: Hand-Painted Artistry, Made with Love, Custom Crafted, and Premium Quality
A photo carousel (4 slides) shows behind-the-scenes and artistic imagery -- click through the slide buttons to demonstrate
The bottom of the page has a 'Get In Touch' contact form -- point it out but do NOT click Send Message
Keep this section brief -- one or two sentences on origin, then move on
AGENT NOTE: Do NOT click button-send-message or the Instagram links (a-see-more, a-12) -- they either have no backend or open an external tab

steps.goal: Show how visitors can reach out or start a conversation with the brand
talking_points: The Contact page provides multiple ways to connect: Email (hello@classycolorshandpainted.com), Instagram DM (@classy_colours_handpainted_hue), and a direct message form
The form collects First Name, Last Name, Email, a Subject (General Inquiry, Shipping Question, Collaboration Opportunity), and a Message
At the bottom there is a call-to-action nudging visitors toward Custom Orders if they're looking for something unique
This is the best page to land on if a visitor has a specific question before purchasing
AGENT NOTE: Do NOT click button-send-message or a-7 (Instagram link) -- they have no backend or open an external tab. Use a-explore-custom-orders if you want to navigate to custom orders
